races.verdict: ZARA'S DREAM didn't shape with masses of promise in a bumper at Ballinrobe 3 months ago but she couldn't be in better hands and will surely up her game here. races.display_title: Bet 20 Pound Get 20 Pound With Unibet Handicap
races.verdict: A good quality handicap. COLOMBIER looked seriously unlucky not to add to his tally in a Goodwood handicap back in July and with his latest run in France best overlooked (looked after when chance had gone) he looks worthy of siding with to prove his mark an exploitable one on all-weather debut. Valvano has an unexposed profile himself on this surface and is a threat, along with Force and Valour . Cosi Bello completes the dangers. COLOMBIER VALVANO (IRE) FORCE AND VALOUR (IRE)
